_comment: Fictional persona for SOH-221 stress data. No real people.
name: Talia Rosen
about_me: I'm Talia, I run a half-acre urban farm in Detroit's North End and sit on the Grown Together Detroit board. I want affordable soil sensors and grant money for a hoop house.
goals: Fund a hoop house for the farm

debriefs.text: Julia Brennan, who runs Grown Together Detroit, is pushing sensors in every garden by spring and wants me to test SoilSense first.
Met Diego Ramirez, SoilSense founder. He offered two free sensors in exchange for feedback.
Elena Ortiz at the Great Lakes Innovation Fund said urban ag projects are eligible for pilot grants. Deadline January 10.
Tomasz Nowak, the Kestrel chef, buys greens from us and wants microgreens year-round.
